summary: The CriminalRecordsCheckEditAll class is part of the HSPnet.UserControls.Enrollment namespace and is responsible for managing the enrollment process, specifically handling the editing and validation of criminal records checks for students. The class includes grid-based data management, sorting, filtering, and user interaction handling through events.
purpose: The purpose of the CriminalRecordsCheckEditAll class is to provide a user control that facilitates the editing and validation of criminal records checks in the student enrollment process. This control supports sorting, filtering, and managing student data related to criminal records checks.

workflows.name: Data Binding and Management
steps: Bind data to gridDataEdit upon certain actions.
Databind gridDataEdit when not in async postback.
Sort data based on user interactions.

workflows.name: Row Command Handling
steps: Handle commands such as cmdSaveAll and cmdSaveEditNext.
Update student data based on command execution.
Redirect users based on the outcome of command execution.
